en: Black‑and‑white view of a large multi‑storey institutional building complex, likely a school, hospital, or administrative facility. The architecture is early‑20th‑century European with steep tiled roofs, dormer windows, arched entranceways, and tall rectangular windows. Bare deciduous trees line a dirt or cobblestone street in the foreground, with a low stone wall and iron fence bordering the property. Additional similar buildings extend into the distance on the left, and gentle hills or fields are visible in the background.
